menna-poulain-2014-bosphorus-ke.citation: Menna and Poulain (2014), Geostrophic currents and kinetic energies in the Black Sea estimated from merged drifter and satellite altimetry data, Ocean Science 10, 155-165, doi:10.5194/os-10-155-2014.
menna-poulain-2014-bosphorus-ke.access: Original open-access publisher PDF acquired and SHA-verified; actual pages 1, 4, 5 and 8 reviewed. Numeric references transcribed from the source prose, not read from saturated figure colors.

records.case_label: Bosphorus regional surface residual kinetic energy, 1999-2009 study
records.source_locator: Equation 6, printed page 158 / PDF page 4; section 3.2.2, printed page 159 / PDF page 5; Figure 5, printed page 162 / PDF page 8.
records.definition: Source-reported regional kinetic energy per unit mass of daily surface geostrophic velocity residuals after removal of the mean flow; meridionally averaged between 41 and 42.5 N.
records.scope: Named recurrent Bosphorus region. Regional residual-energy diagnostic, not an individual tracked eddy or a total/circum-averaged swirl-speed measurement.
records.qualification: Native energy units and source comparison retained. Generally below is not an absolute upper bound. The interaction value belongs to the joint Bosphorus-Sakarya regional signal and is not independently assigned to either component. No square-root speed conversion, outer size, depth, physical footprint, ranking, state intersection, annual envelope or seasonal playback inferred. Figure color saturation is not an upper bound on the prose value.
records.period_label: 1999-2009 study coverage; typical comparison, not an observed uninterrupted eddy lifetime
